claims.claim: The thirty-year mortgage rate index reached 7.59 percent on October 7.
claims.episode_span: Rate-sensitive TFSA holdings face pressure as the thirty-year mortgage rate index hits seven point five nine percent.
claims.source_title: 30-Year Mortgage Rate Index Hits 7.59% on Oct 7
claims.supporting_quote: The index rose to 7.59% on October 7 after opening rate sheets briefly topped 7.7% earlier in the day.

claims.claim: The U.S. Treasury sold $22 billion in 30-year bonds at a high yield of 5.618% on October 8.
claims.episode_span: Bond yields remain elevated after the Treasury sold twenty-two billion dollars of thirty-year bonds at a five point six one eight percent clearing yield, the highest since two thousand.
claims.supporting_quote: The U.S. Treasury sold $22 billion in 30-year bonds at a high yield of 5.618% on October 8, marking the highest clearing yield for a 30-year auction since August 10, 2000.

claims.claim: Enbridge has increased dividends for 31 consecutive years and offers a forward yield of approximately 5.9%.
claims.episode_span: The current five point nine percent yield on Enbridge offers a concrete example of how inflation-protected cash flows compound tax-free inside a TFSA.
claims.source_title: The Ideal TFSA Stock: A 5.9% Yield-Paying Constant Cash
claims.supporting_quote: With a forward dividend yield of approximately 5.9%, Enbridge offers income-seeking investors an attractive combination of recurring income and long-term wealth-creation potential.

claims.supporting_quote: Unitholders of record on October 19, 2026 will receive cash distributions payable on October 23, 2026.
